## 3. Image source and licensing register

Every photograph below was **supplied to us by the client** (Maxwell, Dindu Digitals) on 24 Oct 2026 as a product picture. The original website or photographer was not recorded, so **permission to reuse is not confirmed for any of them**. They are bundled in `public/products/` (no hotlinking) and flagged `CLIENT_SUPPLIED` in the database and admin console.

The shell in the build environment can reach only package registries, and the Nigerian pharmacy sites consulted (HealthPlus, GoMed) publish all-rights-reserved notices with no image-reuse terms, so no image was downloaded from any third-party site.

### To record when permission is obtained

For each photograph: who owns it (manufacturer, distributor or photographer), the written permission or licence, the date, and any attribution wording. Update **Photo permission** and **Where the photo came from** on the product in the admin console, or replace the photograph with one the pharmacy has taken itself (Products → the product → Picture).

### Applies to every product

- Confirm the exact pack the pharmacy stocks matches the photograph (several photographed packs are foreign-market packs; see “Pack market” above).
- Confirm the NAFDAC registration number from the pack or the NAFDAC register and enter it in the product record.
- Confirm the selling price (all are provisional sample prices) and tick “Price confirmed”. The shop will not publish a live product until this is done.
- Pharmacist sign-off on the “sold as” classification, in particular the three items set conservatively to pharmacist only (nos. 1, 15, 21).
